name: Qualcomm Adreno & ARM Mali GPU Driver Exploit / Sandbox Escape (CVE-2026-21385 / CVE-2025-5420)
description: Flags native ELF binaries and embedded shared libraries (.so) attempting memory corruption and integer overflows on kernel graphics device interfaces (/dev/kgsl-3d0, /dev/mali0) to break out of unprivileged app and browser renderer sandboxes.
remediation: Quarantine the offending file immediately. Apply manufacturer firmware update containing Google March 2026 or later security patch level.
